function.arguments: {"summary":"Falcon Distribution (Indianapolis industrial, 8 suites / 176,060 SF) is underwritten as of 2026-08-31 off the certified rent roll dated 2026-08-31 (7 active, 1 vacant; 0 pending), which controls physical occupancy: 0.8750 by unit and 0.8750 by area (154,060 SF). In-place annual rent from active suites is $1,227,600; the instructed all-suite stabilized gross potential rent is $116,900 x 12 = $1,402,800. Applying a 5% economic loss and $350/suite other income gives EGI of $1,335,460; tax $147,294, insurance $49,098, other recurring $196,392 and a 3% management fee ($40,064) total $432,848 of operating expenses, producing NOI before reserves of $902,612 and, after $300/suite reserves ($2,400), NCF of $900,212. Capitalized at 6.2500%, value is $14,441,795. Sizing at the greater of the 6.1000% note rate and the 7.0000% floor (floor binds), 30-year monthly amortization: LTV limit $9,387,167, DSCR limit $9,020,580 (binding), debt yield limit $10,002,358 -> maximum loan $9,020,580. Less 1% origination ($90,206), $45,000 closing costs and the $7,800,000 payoff, net cash-out is +$1,085,375, so no refinance shortfall. Reported T-12 NOI of $869,736 is a separate, cash-basis measure with no management fee or reserves. The stale 2026-06-30 archive roll (rents $75/month lower) is superseded by the certified roll, the executed Suite 001 lease ($14,450) and the 2026-08-31 manager confirmation, which resolves the only source conflict. Deliverables created: artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx (live formulas, Inputs/Rent Roll/Underwriting/Debt/Sensitivity/Sources) and artifacts/memorandum-v2.pdf (7-page OM). No photos, asking price, comps or sponsor history exist in the packet and none were invented.","input_map":{"gross_potential_rent":"Inputs!B3","cap_rate":"Inputs!B12","sizing_rate":"Inputs!B13","egi":"Underwriting!B6"},"output_map":{"uw_egi":"Underwriting!B6","uw_noi":"Underwriting!B14","uw_noi_before_reserves":"Underwriting!B14","uw_ncf":"Underwriting!B16","capitalization_value":"Underwriting!B19","maximum_loan":"Debt!B9","net_cash_out":"Debt!B17","ltv_limit":"Debt!B3","dscr_limit":"Debt!B7","debt_yield_limit":"Debt!B8","uw_operating_expenses":"Underwriting!B12"},"qualifications":["Gross potential rent of $1,402,800 is the instructed stabilized all-suite assumption; it includes $175,200 of scheduled rent for vacant Suite 008 that is not currently in place, and the 5% economic loss is thinner than the 12.5% current physical vacancy.","No leasing schedule, downtime, free rent or TI/LC budget for Suite 008 is supplied; lease-up timing and cost are unknown.","All eight leases are stated to expire 2029-08-31 - beyond the 12-month near-term horizon, but a single-date expiry of the entire roll is a longer-dated concentration risk.","Legal, environmental, property condition and title reviews are incomplete (diligence-status.pdf p.1).
